name: Summer With You
source:
The story follows two girls who end up on a deserted island that seems to have strange properties. Distraught by the situation and troubled by her not-so-platonic feelings toward her best friend, Terra is faced with a few tough choices.

[From [url=https://canofcians.itch.io/summer-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了两个女孩来到一个荒岛上，岛上似乎有着奇怪的特性。泰拉对这种情况感到心烦意乱，并为她对最好的朋友的不那么柏拉图式的感情所困扰，她面临着一些艰难的选择。

[来自[url=https://canofcians.itch.io/summer-with-you]itch.io[/url]]
